$comment: SkillLatch decision receipt v2. Documentation-grade: the reference parser in skilllatch/core.py is authoritative. Known looseness vs the parser and verifier: (1) digest self-consistency (digest == sha256 of the canonical receipt minus digest) is not expressible — use skilllatch.receipts.verify_receipt; (2) calendar validity of evaluated_at is not verified beyond the pattern; (3) the reason_code enum accepts codes such as duplicate_json_key that the evaluation pipeline only raises, never records (they appear only in CLI-synthesized denial receipts); (4) duplicate object keys and nonfinite numbers are invisible to JSON Schema; (5) JSON Schema 'integer' accepts 1.0, the parser requires a type-exact int.

workspace_id.$comment: Deliberately unconstrained beyond string|null: the receipt echoes the host-supplied workspace identity verbatim, even one the engine would reject as policy input, because it binds what was supplied.
